reviewScope.summary: Owner-directed editorial and visual-learning revision across all seven Git & GitHub Pathways modules, including explanation, practical guidance, goals, prompts, choices, hints, feedback and shared Git presentation.
evidence: Inspected authored sources, generated lessons, Git copy, renderer, answer widgets and user screenshot. Revised all 47 lessons; 119 of 507 flow blocks changed compared with master cc502c6. 92 command blocks retain original commands, outputs and error fields. All 113 exercise IDs, option IDs, correct choices, evaluator modes, optionality, required-practice settings, lesson topology and skill/unit metadata are unchanged.

Verified source and original asset SHA-256 during each regeneration; updated index, modules, catalogue and offline manifest together. 56 exercise content hashes change as a consequence of editorial changes; existing history retention semantics apply.

Used the existing Markup renderer for headings, lists and fenced status/branch examples; scoped inline literal highlighting, answer spacing and reading layout to Git. No new learning verification mechanism or storage change.

Prior PR candidate passed all three E2E shards and pilot validation; the unit stage stopped at Prettier in four files. Adjusted the flagged formatting and simplified affected control selectors; the current candidate still requires its own hosted validation. Local Prettier, exporter and browser execution are unavailable here.

adversarialFindings.description: Long prose, ambiguous references and visually undifferentiated technical terms obscured the lesson action and the distinction between staged and unstaged changes.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Split scenarios into short paragraphs and lists, retained exact Git status output and commands, added branch and fetch/pull diagrams, and improved exercise wording and scoped literal highlighting.

adversarialFindings.description: Revising existing exercise text changes content hashes, so previous answers may no longer be presented as current answers.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Preserved all IDs and evaluation rules, retained historical answers under existing storage semantics, and did not introduce a migration or new checking mechanism.

retrospective.summary: Scoped implementer review PASS for the inspected payload; no independent review or additional owner review required. Production remains conditional on the existing automated engineering checks for this exact candidate.
